prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game item atlas and clean image-to-3D references for MAREA NEGRA, a stylized pirate survival adventure.
Create ONE landscape transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY SIX independent objects arranged in a precise 3-column by 2-row evenly spaced grid. Canvas ratio 3:2, preferably 3072x2048 or the highest useful resolution. Every cell occupies exactly one third of canvas width and one half of canvas height. No grid lines. Each prop centered in its own cell, full silhouette inside central 72% of cell, generous truly transparent gutters.
Exact row-major subjects:
Top left: ONE whole raw silver-blue tropical fish with fins and tail, lying horizontally in a slight three-quarter view, fresh blue-silver skin, NOT cooked.
Top center: ONE ripe golden-yellow and orange mango with a tiny attached green leaf, whole fruit, not a basket or pile.
Top right: ONE squat open coarse beige cloth flour sack, flour visible at its opening, no loose flour or spoon outside the sack.
Bottom left: ONE plain round light golden sailor hardtack biscuit, modest thickness, several small docking holes, no garnish, no pile.
Bottom center: ONE dark green corked rum bottle, short neck, chunky antique silhouette, visible amber tint in the lower glass, no label or emblem.
Bottom right: ONE blue glazed ceramic drinking-water flask with a cork, compact round body and short neck, visibly different from the rum bottle, no label or emblem.
Style: consistent stylized hand-painted 3D game prop illustrations, chunky readable proportions, faceted painterly color planes, warm natural material colors with cool marine blue accents. Match the friendly pirate adventure art direction, not photorealistic, not flat vector. Beautiful volume and careful material definition suitable for 3D reconstruction. NO black ink outline. All props at consistent three-quarter slightly elevated camera view. Soft neutral studio lighting, highlights restrained, no baked cast shadows or ground plane. No text, letters, labels, numbers, icons, logo, frame, watermark, extra objects, overlapping subjects, decorative backgrounds. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the six objects, no checkerboard pattern painted into the image. This is a cuttable atlas, not a scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent game-prop sprite atlas for a pirate survival adventure, also used as individual references for 3D modeling.
Create exactly SIX separate objects, not a scene. Landscape 3:2 canvas, 3 columns and 2 rows. Absolutely no background, genuinely transparent alpha outside the objects. Each object fits ENTIRELY within the central 70% width and 76% height of its equal grid cell. Keep broad transparent gutters so no subject approaches neighboring cells. No grid lines, no text or labels.
Exact row-major order:
1 TOP LEFT: one whole roasted tropical fish, horizontal, golden brown with a few dark grill marks, intact head and tail and simplified fins. No plate, skewer, herbs, lemon, vegetables, smoke or flame.
2 TOP CENTER: one sturdy rustic wooden tankard filled with amber grog, wood staves, two dull metal bands, one curved handle. Liquid surface just visible. No foam, garnish, straw, label or emblem. Short chunky silhouette.
3 TOP RIGHT: one large thick golden-brown reinforced sailor biscuit, a single round baked hardtack with cross-scored top, rough baked flour texture and toasted edge. It must be visibly thicker, darker and heartier than an ordinary pale biscuit. No seeds, nuts, berries or toppings.
4 BOTTOM LEFT: one small coarse beige cloth salt pouch standing open with a modest mound of off-white sea-salt crystals contained INSIDE the opening. No scattered pile or spoon.
5 BOTTOM CENTER: one whole bright green lime, slightly oval, dimpled skin and tiny stem. No slice, leaf, plate or other fruit.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT: one compact small bundle of aromatic green herbs tied together at stems with a simple tan string. Broad chunky stylized leaves, readable silhouette, no loose leaves, bowl, label or other objects.
Style: polished stylized hand-painted 3D game props, slightly faceted painterly planes, chunky readable shapes, rich natural colors, convincing matte materials, gentle studio highlights. Friendly pirate adventure visual direction. NOT photorealistic, NOT flat vector. NO thick black ink outlines. Consistent three-quarter view from slightly above, soft neutral lighting. Full objects visible, centered with ample margin. No cast ground shadow, no ground plane, no lighting halo, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no frame, no watermark, no icon symbols. Each cell contains one isolated physical prop only. Preserve high-quality real alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production cuttable transparent sprite atlas, two independent pirate-survival game items for UI icons and single-object 3D modeling reference.
Landscape canvas 3:2 ratio. EXACTLY two objects arranged side by side, centered at 25% and 75% of canvas width. Generous fully transparent margins, entire objects visible, no overlap. Each silhouette stays inside its half of the canvas.
LEFT: one single short segment of fresh cut sugar cane, a sturdy slightly curved green-yellow jointed stalk with clear ring nodes and a light freshly cut fibrous end. Diagonal from lower left to upper right, no bundle, rope, leaves or other stalks.
RIGHT: one small squat open cinnamon-brown cloth spice pouch with reddish-brown ground spice visible contained inside the opening, neatly rolled cloth rim, no spilled powder, spoon, cinnamon sticks or other spices around it.
Style: polished stylized hand-painted 3D game props, chunky readable proportions, painterly faceted color planes, gentle neutral studio light, warm natural colors, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Match a friendly pirate survival adventure. NO black ink outline, not photorealistic, not flat vector. No text, letters, labels, emblems, frame, grid line, watermark, shadow under the objects, ground plane, background, or decorative scene. Genuine alpha transparency outside the two isolated objects; no checkerboard painted pixels.
